items.stem: What is the name given to years that have 29 February?
How many days are there in February 2024?
If a person is born on 04/07/2014 and another on 04/12/2019, how many years older is the first person?
If July 1 is a Monday, what day of the week will August 1 fall on?
If a person wakes up at 6:00 AM and goes to sleep at 10:00 PM, how many hours are they awake in a day?
What is the name of the day that comes after Sunday?
How many days are there in February 2024?
If a doctor works from 6 AM to 6 PM and then from 6 PM to 6 AM the next day, how many hours does he work in total?
If today is Wednesday, what day was it yesterday?
If Raghav leaves home at 8:20 AM and returns at 8:35 AM, how long did his trip take?
If July 1 is a Monday, what date will be the next Monday?
If a person was born on 29 February 2016, which year will they celebrate their 4th birthday?
